question: What is the Full Form of BCCI?

options.text: Board of Control of Cycling in India
Board of Control for Cricket in India

solution:
The correct answer is​** Board of Control for Cricket in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Here are some details about BCCI:**

 
 
• The **BCCI is the national governing body for cricket in India, responsible for all cricket activities in the country.**
 
• Founded in December **1928**, it is affiliated to the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• BCCI operates the Indian Premier League (IPL), a professional **Twenty20 cricket league in India.**
 
• **The board also conducts domestic tournaments like the Ranji Trophy, Duleep Trophy, and Vijay Hazare Trophy.**
